title: Mirabel and the Confession
author: Wendell Delacroix
blurb: Zephyrine Oyelaran, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
